rows.source: Bestson: Однажды в парке на меня похожий мужик напал. Я с того момента в этот парк ни ногой!
rows.target: Bestson: Једном ме је у парку напао мушкарац који личи на мене. Од тада нећу ни да привирим у тај парк!
rows.reason: Russian на меня похожий мужик explicitly permits a man resembling me. The context also permits a similar man referring to the resident, but ambiguity does not establish the existing interpretation is a mistranslation. No objective replacement.

rows.source: FortuneTeller: Скажи, что от меня. Обязательно!
rows.target: FortuneTeller: Реци да долазиш од мене. Обавезно!
rows.reason: Phone referral context permits the metaphorical coming from someone formulation. More explicit на моју препоруку would be a preference, not an objective source/target error.

sourceInconsistencies: Some source dialogue uses male/default referents where same-place data includes women, and Marauder source has feminine эта despite male Bald being a candidate. These source facts remain source facts; only avoidable target grammar/additional gender commitments are proposed as target corrections. Rocker and Foreigner male pronouns were checked against actual all-male supported label candidates, not guessed from a generic roster.
